visual.pregunta: Distinguish between an open system, a closed system and an isolated system.
visual.floja: An open system is open, a closed system is closed and an isolated system is isolated from everything. A forest is open.
tachar: An open system is open, a closed system is closed
visual.porque: It repeats the question. Distinguish needs energy and matter for each type.
puntos: Open: exchanges energy and matter (pond, forest)
visual.clave: Energy and matter, for every type

visual.mal: In an ecosystem, energy cycles and matter flows.
visual.bien: Energy flows through: in as sunlight, out as heat. Matter cycles between storages.

opciones: The system becomes more stable and resilient
Extra complexity hides useful information about it
The system turns into a closed system
